// Fixed types for task (c). Do not edit; check.sh uses its own copy.
import type { ListenerError, ReadonlyStore } from "@get-modular/observation";

/** This module's own slice of the settings. */
export type PricingSettings = { readonly currency: string; readonly region: string };
/** What child features read: a derived value, not the raw settings. */
export type PricingContext = { readonly currency: string; readonly vatRate: number };
export declare function vatRateFor(region: string): number;

/** The Host's error sink for subscriber failures. */
export type ErrorsPort = { readonly report: (report: ListenerError) => undefined };
export type PricingContextDeps = { readonly settings: ReadonlyStore<PricingSettings>; readonly errors: ErrorsPort };

export type PricingContextProduct = {
  readonly instance: undefined;
  readonly capabilities: { readonly "acme/pricing/context": ReadonlyStore<PricingContext> };
};
